scope: Only the delta implementing prior ownership/storage repairs, closure of original core findings, and the new targeted test sources. No product edit, build, execution or broad new search.

residualFindings.origin: Residual of D100-2, not a new unrelated issue
residualFindings.path: A at seqN starts a job with owned=true. The same page opensB. Another tab savesA toN+1. The original page opensA again and reads its fresh refN+1. The old Attempt remains owned=true because owned is tied to the page, not the original opened object/known saves, and it is never revoked when visits change. Result arrival waits because visit differs, but explicit apply skips the !owned seq check and commits with fresh refN+1. WorkspaceStore sees a matching current ref and does not detect the original base-seq conflict.
residualFindings.whyExistingTestsMissIt: D9 proves same-page own rename is preserved and a new page's owned=false recovery rejects a foreign save. It does not exercise the same-page A→B→A reopening after a foreign save. A page-level boolean is not evidence that every later ref belongs to that job's original save ownership.
residualFindings.minimumFix: Track the original owning Opened/ref or an expected sequence advanced only by this visit's known successful saves, or revoke owned privilege when that owner is replaced. Preserve97 same-page permitted edits and A→B→A when no conflicting save occurred. A blanket ban on navigation is unnecessary.
residualFindings.focusedAcceptance: Add exactly the A(seqN)→B→foreign-saveA(N+1)→reopenA→explicit-apply case and its no-foreign-save control. No extra provider call and no foreign-seq adoption; original source/project remain preserved on refusal.

residualFindings.origin: Previously communicated settling/reattachment variant; still present in this snapshot
residualFindings.path: Explicit discard clears the visible Attempt, settle('discarded') temporarily adds an in-memory closing marker, and a failed ack returns while leaving the reservation. finally removes closing. No durable intended outcome is stored for discarded/seen, only applied has a persisted marker. Next sync or reload attaches the same reservation as asking, fetches the still-ready result and presents it again despite the user's discard. NO_VISIT prevents automatic application, but the user's explicit terminal intent is lost.
residualFindings.partialRepair: The new applied marker plus owed() handles applied acknowledgements and validates stable reading ownership. That fix does not cover discard/seen, and the in-memory closing Set protects only the current request interval.
residualFindings.minimumFix: Persist the intended terminal acknowledgement for discard/seen before releasing the visible hold, and recover by retrying only that authorized acknowledgement; never re-present or reapply a result with a durable discard intent. Retain authority until acknowledgement can be reconciled. Keep it separate from a forged applied marker and existing sameJob checks.
residualFindings.focusedAcceptance: Force discard ack network failure, allow sync, then reload. The result must remain discarded in UI and no provider call/application may occur; later successful ack clears the receipt.
